findings.message: One shoulder sits consistently lower than the other - level the shoulder line.
Your neck juts forward of your shoulders; lengthen the back of the neck.
Your arm swing is off - aim for a relaxed, even swing from the shoulder.
Your left and right sides move by noticeably different amounts.
Your two arms swing by different amounts.
Open the chest and draw the shoulder blades back - presence starts with carriage.
Your arms are not opposing your legs; the swing should alternate with the stride.
Your two legs are not swinging equally.
Add a little controlled torso rotation - the walk currently reads as stiff.

quality_warnings: Clip is only 1.7s; at least 4-6 seconds (4+ strides) gives a stable reading.

coaching.headline: Foundational walk - 31/100. Start with posture and balance.
coaching.summary: Across twelve criteria your strongest work is walking confidence, and the biggest single gain available is in shoulder alignment. Work the 3 focus area(s) below before adding anything else.

focus_areas.label: Shoulder Alignment
focus_areas.issue: One shoulder sits consistently lower than the other - level the shoulder line.

focus_areas.label: Posture & Spinal Alignment
focus_areas.issue: Your neck juts forward of your shoulders; lengthen the back of the neck.

focus_areas.label: Arm Swing
focus_areas.issue: Your arm swing is off - aim for a relaxed, even swing from the shoulder.

drills.name: Shoulder reset
drills.instruction: Roll both shoulders up, back and down before each pass; walk keeping the collarbones wide.

drills.name: Mirror check
drills.instruction: Walk toward a mirror and watch the shoulder line stay level across every step.

drills.name: Wall alignment
drills.instruction: Stand with heels, hips, shoulders and head touching a wall. Hold, step away keeping the shape, and walk five metres.

drills.name: Book walk
drills.instruction: Walk with a book balanced on your head. Keep the ribcage stacked over the pelvis rather than leaning to hold it.

drills.name: Relaxed pendulum
drills.instruction: Walk letting the arms swing from the shoulder, elbows soft. Do not drive them; let the stride move them.

drills.name: Even swing
drills.instruction: Walk counting the swing of each arm; match the two amplitudes.
